p: Gillingham High Street is one of the main shopping streets in the Medway towns, and it's a mainly pedestrianised run of everyday shops, cafés and takeaways.

If you've got time, there's real history close by. The Royal Engineers Museum in Gillingham is packed with military stories, and the Great Lines Heritage Park, a big green space between Gillingham and Chatham, is great for a walk. Chatham's Historic Dockyard is a short trip away for a full day out. On match days Priestfield Stadium, home of Gillingham FC, brings crowds into town. Admiral is an adults-only gaming centre, so it's 18+ and not one for the family.
